title: Hearty Croatian Gorgonzola Pasta
description: A kid-friendly Croatian dish featuring gorgonzola-dolce and bonito-shave, this flexitarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It combines resinous and glassy-jelly textures for a unique taste experience.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook until they start to release their juices.
Stir in the gorgonzola-dolce and cook until it starts to melt and combine with the tomatoes.
Add the bonito flakes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the gorgonzola and tomato mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
